payload.summary: The council's tenant satisfaction measures for 2025/26 — the set the Regulator of Social Housing requires every landlord to publish, from a survey of 1,002 Norwich tenants "Between 6 May 2025 and 5 March 2026". The page carries 22: twelve from the tenant survey and ten the landlord works out from its own records. Three quarters of tenants, 75.3%, were satisfied with the overall service, up from 71.1% the year before. Satisfaction with how complaints are handled was 30.0%. The council publishes no target for any of them.
